mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dict ( dict_name, dict_code, dict_key, dict_str_val, dict_num_val, dict_desc, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_del ) VALUES ( #{dictName}, #{dictCode}, #{dictKey}, #{dictStrVal}, #{dictNumVal}, #{dictDesc}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now(), false )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dict WHERE is_del = false AND dict_name IS NOT NULL AND dict_name != '' ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM dict WHERE is_del = false AND dict_code = #{dictCode} AND dict_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dict_key ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE dict SET is_del = true, update_time = now() WHERE uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid)

UPDATE dict SET dict_name = #{dictName}, dict_code = #{dictCode}, dict_key = #{dictKey}, dict_str_val = #{dictStrVal}, dict_num_val = #{dictNumVal}, dict_desc = #{dictDesc}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() WHERE uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid) AND is_del = false
